name: Pi Dash
description: Pi Dash turns project issues into executable work for Claude, and other coding agents. Assign tasks, run agents on connected development machines, track progress and approvals, and review tested results in one place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pi Dash to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pi Dash to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pidash.airepublic.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pi Dash MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pi Dash lists 17 MCP tools, including pidash_attach_github_pull_request, pidash_comment_issue, pidash_create_issue, pidash_get_issue, pidash_get_project, pidash_get_workpad, pidash_list_comments, pidash_list_github_pull_requests, pidash_list_issues, pidash_list_projects, pidash_list_states, and pidash_move_issue.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pi Dash?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pi Dash in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Pi Dash MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pi Dash requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pi Dash is developed by AI Republic. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
